title: Review as Code Finding
description: Optional machine-readable projection of a RaC finding file, derived per SPEC Section 15.1. Markdown remains the canonical human-readable format. Additional properties are permitted so repositories MAY extend the record.

id.description: The finding's local ID, e.g. F001. The canonical globally unique ID R###-F### is derived from the review directory and this value (SPEC Section 7).

decision.description: Recommended values from SPEC Section 8.1. Repositories MAY use other values.

verification.description: Recommended values from SPEC Section 8.2. Repositories MAY use other values.
